gymnopedies.piece: 3 Gymnopedies (No. 1 Lent et douloureux, No. 2 Lent et triste, No. 3 Lent et grave)
gymnopedies.performer: see notes — pick a clearly-licensed recording, or generate your own
gymnopedies.notes: IMPORTANT: the *composition* is fully public domain, but recording licenses differ. Musopen hosts recordings it treats as public domain (free account required to download) — verify the individual track. Community archive.org uploads (e.g. identifier 'Satie_Gymnopedies', all three movements; or 'SatiesThreeGymnopedies' by S. Robert Powell) do NOT state a recording license explicitly, so treat them as prototype-only unless you confirm status. CLEANEST PATH for production: because the composition is PD, just generate your own Satie performance (see INSTYLE_PROMPTS['satie_optional']) — zero recording-rights risk, and you get tempo/key control.

rain_and_nature.license: filter to CC0 for no-attribution commercial use (CC-BY also available)
rain_and_nature.notes: Rebuild the 'with rain' version yourself: PD Gymnopedie bed + CC0 rain layer = you own the whole mix and its license end to end.

spiegel_style.inspiration: Arvo Part, 'Spiegel im Spiegel' (1978) — DO NOT reproduce the theme
spiegel_style.ace_step_tags: ambient classical, solo piano and violin, tintinnabuli, sparse, sustained, meditative, F major, very slow, 52 BPM
spiegel_style.stable_audio_prompt: A deeply calm, meditative piece for solo piano and violin. Sparse, widely-spaced piano notes outlining a simple major triad, rising and falling like a mirror image, over a sustained low drone. A single long violin note floats above. Vast space and silence between notes, no percussion, no rhythm section, F major, extremely slow and still. 60 seconds, seamless, ambient.
variations: solo piano only, no violin, sustained bell-like single notes, glacial, F major, 48 BPM
piano and cello, low register, sacred minimalism, endless sustain, reverberant church space
spiegel_style.avoid: Do not request the specific 3-note rising/falling motif by name or the title; keep the triad generic. Audition for accidental quotation of the real figure.

params.post: reverb tail + crossfade loop to session length

spiegel_style.am_fit: EXCELLENT AM carrier: sustained tones and long silences take an imposed amplitude-gate cleanly. Also ideal as a soundscape over a pure-sine binaural bed.

glass_style.inspiration: Philip Glass, e.g. 'Metamorphosis'/'Mad Rush' — DO NOT reproduce any actual etude
glass_style.ace_step_tags: minimalist piano, repeating broken-chord arpeggios, hypnotic, gentle harmonic shifts, melancholic, minor key, 76 BPM
glass_style.stable_audio_prompt: Hypnotic minimalist solo piano. Continuous, evenly-flowing broken-chord arpeggios in the left and right hand, slowly shifting harmony every few bars, gently melancholic, in a minor key. Steady and trance-like with no drums and no melody on top — just the rippling arpeggio texture. Contemplative, cyclical, 60 seconds, loopable.
variations: add soft sustained synth pad under the piano arpeggios, warm, ambient minimalism
faster rippling arpeggios, brighter major-key sections, urgent but calm, 96 BPM
glass_style.avoid: Keep the arpeggio pattern and chord progression generic-minimalist; do not prompt a specific Glass work or its signature figure. Audition outputs.

params.post: bar-aligned loop; watch for phrase seams

glass_style.am_fit: MUDDIER as an AM carrier — the steady arpeggios already carry a strong rhythmic envelope that fights an imposed gate. Best used as a soundscape layered over a binaural beat.

clayderman_style.inspiration: Richard Clayderman repertoire (comp. Paul de Senneville) — e.g. 'Ballade pour Adeline', 'Mariage d'amour'. DO NOT reproduce these tunes.
clayderman_style.ace_step_tags: romantic solo piano, easy listening, lush, sentimental, gentle rubato, soft strings, major key, 72 BPM
clayderman_style.stable_audio_prompt: A warm, sentimental romantic piano piece in the easy-listening style. Expressive solo piano with gentle rubato and a flowing right-hand melody over rolling left-hand accompaniment, backed by soft lush strings. Tender, nostalgic, major key, cinematic and sweet. No drums. 60 seconds, smooth.
variations: solo piano only, no strings, intimate, close-mic'd, gentle, major key, 68 BPM
piano with soft pad and light harp, dreamy, romantic, slow ballad feel
clayderman_style.avoid: Prompt for the romantic-piano *mood* only. Do NOT request 'Ballade pour Adeline' / 'Mariage d'amour' or their melodies — both are in copyright. Because Clayderman's sound is so melody-driven, audition especially carefully.

params.post: trim to a clean phrase; fade rather than hard-loop

clayderman_style.am_fit: MUDDIER as an AM carrier — rubato and a moving melody give an irregular envelope that blurs the gate. Use as a soundscape over a binaural bed.

satie_optional.piece: Gymnopedie-style slow piano waltz (PD composition — generate freely)
satie_optional.inspiration: Erik Satie Gymnopedies — composition is PUBLIC DOMAIN, no restriction
satie_optional.composition_status: PUBLIC DOMAIN (Satie d. 1925) — you may even reproduce the tune
satie_optional.ace_step_tags: solo piano, slow waltz, 3/4 time, gentle suspended chords, melancholic, tender, sparse, 60 BPM
satie_optional.stable_audio_prompt: A slow, gentle solo piano waltz in 3/4 time. Simple wistful melody over soft suspended chords, unhurried and melancholic but sweet, lots of space, no drums. Reflective and calm, 60 seconds, loopable.
variations: add faint room reverb, intimate upright piano, nostalgic
piano with a very soft string pad underneath, ambient, dreamy 3/4
satie_optional.avoid: None required for copyright (PD). Still audition for musical quality.
satie_optional.am_fit: GOOD AM carrier: slow, sparse, held chords take an imposed gate gracefully. Also fine as a soundscape over a binaural bed.
